note: Single source of truth for the layer graph. Layer names are identical across all four stacks; frameworks differ only in where routing lives (profile.routingRoot).
direction: downward-only: a layer may import any layer strictly below it, and nothing at or above it

variants.note: Axes a repo answers, not a stack property: two repos on the same stack answer differently. Declared here because the layer graph owns what may vary about itself; the chosen value arrives from the interview and is recorded in the target's manifest. Layer direction is not an axis - it is the one constraint every variant keeps.

publicApi.means: enforced: a slice is reachable only through its index.*. open: deep imports into a slice are allowed, and the publicApiEnforced flag on each layer is inert.

sliceCoupling.means: isolated: a slice may not import a sibling slice of its own layer. same-layer: it may. Cross-layer direction is unaffected either way.

routing.note: Framework routing directory. Enabled only when routingRoot is set - by the stack profile, or by an answer when the repo already has one. It may sit outside fsdRoot (Next app/) or inside it (RN src/navigators/); the element is registered before the layers either way, so a routingRoot under fsdRoot still matches routing and not the layer it sits beside.
routing.mayImportNote: Default for a repo whose routing files only register screens. Overridable per repo via the routingImports answer, which must name existing layers.
